diagnosis: The CI/CD build log streaming endpoint uses Transfer-Encoding: chunked to stream build logs matching buildId without checking whether req.user has read permissions on the underlying Git repository. Attackers can stream build output containing environment secrets, deployment keys, and tokens.
exploit_request:
GET /api/builds/bld_deploy_prod_cluster_9918/console-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: ci.devcloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_dev_token>
